title: Where the Fences Forget Their Teaching

features.name: the line no longer lines
features.desc-on-touch: The fence that taught property has fallen or dissolved. Knowledge that was meant to stop at borders has spread into the paddocks beyond.

features.name: the ambulant teaching
features.desc-on-touch: Lessons about surgery and healing, whispered over fences that no longer hold, spread by people moving between properties. Knowledge is no longer contained.

features.name: the drifting word
features.desc-on-touch: Names of procedures, techniques, remedies—carried on wind or by mouth beyond where they were formally taught.

inscription: when fences fall, teaching doesn't stop—it learns to walk

file.name: Midwifery_Knowledge_Boundary_Dissolution.txt
file.note: Case studies of surgical and birthing knowledge spreading from formal hospitals into bush communities, crossing property lines, becoming folk practice.
